title: RENPHO Eyeris 1 Eye Massager with Heat, FSA Eligible HSA, Heated Eye Mask for Head Tension, Eye Strain & Screen Fatigue
features: FSA Eligible HSA & Eye Massager with Heat: This Renpho eye massager with heat qualifies as an FSA/HSA eligible item, allowing you to use your health savings account for purchase.

Relax Your Eyes: Soothe tired eyes and sleep better with the RENPHO sleep eye mask. Combining complete light-blocking coverage with soothing warmth and precision compression massage, it helps ease tightness around your eyes and temples.
180° Foldable & Portable Design: Folds into a compact design so you can carry it to the office, airplane, or while traveling. Adjustable headband suitable for teenagers and adults.
Heat and compression massage: Gentle heat with pressure massage designed to relax the eye area after long screen sessions.
Gift-ready wellness tool: Popular birthday and holiday gift option for people who spend long hours at a computer.

Please note: Vision may blur briefly after use—close your eyes until it clears. Normal operating noise under 45 dB. Not suitable after eye surgery or for serious eye conditions. Check for protein leather allergies before use.
